li.label: pleasant warmth
li.description: I feel a pleasant warmth spreading through my body. This is quite nice.

li.label: giggly
li.description: I can't stop giggling! Everything seems so funny right now.

li.label: joyfully tipsy
li.description: I feel tipsy and joyful! Everything seems more fun!

li.label: euphoric
li.description: I'm euphoric and having the time of my life! This is amazing!

li.label: flesh colony presence
li.description: The colony's beasts move through the shared flesh. Their presence is small, but the rhythm is already comforting.

li.label: many fleshbeasts nearby
li.description: The colony has grown enough bodies to feel like a living crowd around me. I am not alone inside the flesh.

li.label: surrounded by the flesh swarm
li.description: The colony is dense with living beasts. Their weight presses through the shared mind and steadies my thoughts.

li.label: the flesh is everywhere
li.description: The colony is vast, warm, and close. Every beast is another pulse in the same body, and I rest inside it.

li.label: saw living flesh
li.description: I saw living tissue where ordinary walls and floors should be. It is hard to stop thinking about it.

li.label: saw a flesh colony
li.description: The colony's flesh was close enough to see its wet movement and impossible organs. I still feel watched by it.

li.label: surrounded by living flesh
li.description: Living walls, organs, and beasts filled the space around me. The memory keeps crawling back into my thoughts.

li.label: the flesh was everywhere
li.description: I stood inside a vast body of floors, organs, and beasts. For a moment the whole place felt alive and hungry.

li.label: flesh tentacle accepted
li.description: The tentacle is no longer an alien growth, but another limb of the colony's shared flesh.

li.label: flesh whip accepted
li.description: The living whip is no longer alien. It serves the colony's shared flesh.

li.label: fleshmass stomach accepted
li.description: The stomach's acid is part of the colony's metabolism.

li.label: fleshmass lung accepted
li.description: The lung renews itself in rhythm with the colony's flesh.

li.label: ate strange biomass
li.description: I ate a warm mass of unfamiliar living tissue. It was nourishing, but I would rather not know what was moving inside it.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s soothing pulse
li.description: {WEAPON} settles into a slow pulse against my hand. The rhythm steadies my thoughts.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s predatory appetite
li.description: {WEAPON} wants fresh meat and quick cuts. Its hunger makes violence feel easy.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s restless nerves
li.description: {WEAPON} twitches and mutters through the grip. Its stray impulses keep crawling under my skin.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s guarding will
li.description: {WEAPON} curls its awareness around me, alert and protective. I feel watched over.
